prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
A uniform SATURATED HOT ORANGE-RED flat color field — think #E64A2E,
the color of rupture, exile, and inheritance broken open on a semantic
map. The hue must read as HOT ORANGE-RED, not tan, not brown, not the
cool crimson of lineage. Clearly distinct from wastes ochre and beacon
gold. Fill the ENTIRE 1024x1024 square edge-to-edge with this one
orange-red color corner to corner — NO drawn hex, NO paper border, NO
vignette, NO centered composition, NO symbols, NO cracks, NO figures,
NO script. Only the faintest paint-texture variation within the same
orange-red hue. A semantic terrain region-fill swatch, not an
illustration.

formatted_prompt.scene: Vibrant game-map terrain tile rendered in bold comic-book ink wash, a flat hot orange-red color field filling the entire square edge to edge, faint brushstroke texture variation within a single searing vermillion hue, no figures, no symbols.

subjects.description: Edge-to-edge saturated hot orange-red wash, uniform hue with only the faintest paint-drag texture variation across the surface, fully filling all four corners
